description: He wears a brown textured knee-length tunic with narrow gold-toned woven trim at its split rounded neckline, fitted sleeve cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the neck, wrists and beneath the tunic hem. A sturdy dark brown leather belt with a brass-colored rectangular buckle secures the waist, with a long loose belt end and a small leather pouch at the hip. Muted brown narrow trousers and soft brown leather boots complete the outfit. Fabrics appear wool-like over linen-like cloth; exact fibers are uncertain. The design has restrained decoration and covers torso and limbs completely, without headgear, armor or weapons.
